resources.string: Reads real FGO text without OCR. Browsing is read-only; asset tests require separate confirmation. No translation API calls. Only the verified JP format and primary Android user are supported.
Shizuku is not installed. Install and start it first.
Shizuku is not running, or the reader was disconnected. Start Shizuku, then refresh.
Unsupported environment: requires Shizuku 13+, non-root ADB mode, and the primary Android user.
Connect to authorize and start the read-only service.
Shizuku permission was denied. Change it in Shizuku’s authorized apps, then retry.
Connection failed. Check Shizuku permission and running status, then retry.
Could not open. Install a browser or Shizuku first.
These are asset groups, not chapter names or account progress. Open a group to browse its real script IDs. Leaving this screen releases the reader; reconnect and scan when you return.
No supported installed story assets found.
Parsed text fields: %1$d. Native commands are preserved in the raw script.
API translation is not enabled. Experimental install/restore has offline validation only; in-game compatibility still requires a separate test.
Only the observed JP test group 01. Write-back is not yet validated in-game. Two game files change only after explicit confirmation. No translation API calls.
FGO was updated. Keep the old backup. A new version may get a separate baseline only if the old test was never prepared or installed. Never restore an old manifest into a new version.
Staged; check or restore before continuing
Test assets installed; verify inside FGO
Recovery export passed read-back. Independently verify your PC copy too.
Export recovery files and verify an independent PC copy before installation.
Replacement/restore in progress. Do not start FGO, update this app or interrupt Shizuku. A process failure requires recovery inspection.
Connect and open ScriptActionEncrypt/01 to create a baseline backup.
Marker testing unlocks after unchanged playback is confirmed and originals restored. Target: the verified plain field in opening script 0100000011.
This stages/verifies and replaces story group 01 plus its manifest. Force stop FGO first. The pair is not one atomic replacement; interruption may require recovery. Account files are not targeted.

After force-stopping FGO, restore exact originals from verified backups. Changed versions or unexpected live files block restoration. Uninstalling this app does not restore FGO and deletes private backups.
Confirm only after replaying the opening scene inside FGO with no unexpected download or error. This is your manual observation, not automatic verification. Then force stop FGO and restore originals.
This is an authorised disposable test installation
I independently verified the original backups on my PC
Install a language pack to show translated text inside FGO. Untranslated chapters stay in Japanese.
No pack available for this language
Originals are backed up automatically before install; restore them here if needed.
Review backups, export a recovery package or restore the original story. Connect Shizuku first.
Could not open the file picker
Translation installed. You can restore the original at any time.
Original restored. Reopen FGO to apply.
